name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
description: Connect Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to monitor device health, security alerts, and vulnerability management across your organization.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Go to Azure Portal → Microsoft Entra ID → App registrations → New registration (e.g. 'CompAI Defender')
2. From the Overview page, copy the Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID
3. Go to Certificates & secrets → New client secret, copy the value (only shown once)
4. Go to API permissions → Add a permission → APIs my organization uses
   IMPORTANT: pick "APIs my organization uses", NOT "Microsoft Graph".
5. Search for and select WindowsDefenderATP (the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint API)
6. Choose Application permissions and add:
   - Machine.Read.All
   - Alert.Read.All
   - Vulnerability.Read.All
7. Click 'Grant admin consent' for your organization
8. Paste the Tenant ID, Client ID, and Client Secret below

Notes:
 - The API is registered in Azure AD under the name 'WindowsDefenderATP' even though Microsoft brands the product as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
 - The OAuth resource/scope is https://api.securitycenter.microsoft.com/.default — Microsoft has consolidated the API URL to api.security.microsoft.com but the token resource remains the legacy URL.
